youtube.description:
Dadi ne poocha: "Anaesthesia se yaadaasht chali jaati hai kya?" 🧠
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Dadi, chinta mat kijiye, zyadatar logon ki yaadaasht theek rehti hai! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Anaesthesia ke baad halki bhool ya uljhan aam taur par kuch minton ya ghanton mein theek ho jaati hai
✅ Buzurgon mein kabhi kuch din uljhan reh sakti hai, jo aksar dheere-dheere theek ho jaati hai — pehle se bhoolne ki pareshani ho toh doctor ko zaroor bataiye
✅ Chashma, hearing aid (aur extra battery) saath laaiye, ghar wale paas rahein aur din-tareekh yaad dilaayein
✅ Anaesthesia ke baad 24 ghante tak koi bada faisla ya kaagaz par sign mat kijiye
